# Callspec

> Spec-first TypeScript RPC: one `route()` registry → server, SDK, MCP, docs, OpenAPI.

Agent entry: AGENTS.md
Human entry: README.md

## Docs

- docs/getting-started.md — install, first route, mount, SDK, client call
- docs/server-layout.md — recommended multi-file route layout
- docs/unit-testing.md — .resolver(input, ctx) with kizu
- docs/complete-example.md — single-file server
- docs/authentication.md — bearer auth, scope
- docs/request-context.md — typed resolver context
- docs/api-reference.md — route, spec, mountSpec index
- docs/error-handling.md — Result contract, mountSpec catch order
- docs/sdk-generation.md — CLI codegen, pinning callspec.json for CI
- docs/client-usage.md — ApiClient, auth headers, React patterns
- docs/shared-validation.md — spec.exports and --validators
- docs/docs-ui.md — /docs explorer
- docs/mcp.md — API-tool MCP at /mcp
- docs/openapi.md — OpenAPI 3.1 export (not SDK input)
- docs/using-fern-with-callspec.md — optional multi-lang DX layer
- docs/development.md — contributing

## Invariants

- Return err.* from resolvers; do not throw expected failures
- SDK codegen uses callspec.json, not openapi.json
- --validators is opt-in; default output is ApiClient
- scope: private omits route from exports, not from server
- Branch client code on result.code when !result.ok

## Ignore

docs/internal/ — plans and maintainer notes, not product docs
